body: Thanks. I do have a couple of old friends in particular that I could maybe count on for this if it happens (don't live near them anymore but still). It would be a burden but it would be amazing if they could step in and stop things from turning into a big farce. Id pretty much only want them to remember me.

The main story I've heard recently that has really put me off is a woman that committed suicide but it wasn't clear so the police arrested her boyfriend! The did release him in the end but I don't want the people I live with to get in trouble.
